title: Facial palsy reveals the sensorimotor contribution to facial-emotion recognition.
summary: Although recognizing emotions from facial expressions appears effortless, the field is divided between vision-based accounts, which posit matching to learned visual templates, and embodied accounts, which posit recruitment of facial motor circuits. We propose an ambiguity-gated, developmentally calibrated architecture in which the recognition system draws on sensorimotor information primarily when visual evidence is insufficient, with early motor experience proposed to shape the threshold and gain of this contribution. We tested this model across three studies (N = 185) integrating dynamic prototypical and nonprototypical expressions, congenital (Moebius syndrome) and acquired facial palsy, and standardized severity grading (Sunnybrook Facial Grading System; SFGS). Neurotypical adults (N = 117) confirmed a robust prototypicality-dependent cost on recognition. Both congenital (N = 15) and acquired (N = 19) cohorts showed severity-performance coupling for nonprototypical expressions, consistent with shared reliance on sensorimotor information when visual evidence is insufficient; only the Moebius cohort showed this coupling also for prototypical expressions, consistent with undercalibrated visual templates following lifelong atypical facial motor experience. Exploratory electroencephalography (EEG) revealed reduced sensorimotor-face-network functional connectivity in Moebius, consistent with altered cross-route integration. Reanalysis of an independent dataset of ultra-ambiguous static morphs replicated severity-performance coupling and revealed Moebius-control mean differences only under high perceptual demand. Together, the findings provide strong behavioral support for an ambiguity-gated, developmentally calibrated architecture and motivate direct tests of how developmental motor experience shapes when-and how strongly-the recognition system draws on sensorimotor information.

标题：面瘫揭示面部情绪识别的感觉运动贡献
摘要：尽管从面部表情中识别情绪看似毫不费力，但该领域在基于视觉的解释与具身解释之间存在分歧：前者认为识别依赖于与习得视觉模板的匹配，后者则认为识别会招募面部运动回路。我们提出一种“模糊性门控、发展性校准”的架构，即识别系统主要在视觉证据不足时才依赖感觉运动信息，并假设早期运动经验会塑造这种贡献的阈值和增益。我们在三项研究（N = 185）中检验了这一模型，整合了动态原型与非原型表情、先天性面瘫（Moebius综合征）与获得性面瘫，以及标准化严重程度分级（Sunnybrook面部分级系统；SFGS）。神经典型成人（N = 117）确认了识别中稳健的、依赖于原型性的代价。先天性（N = 15）和获得性（N = 19）队列均表现出非原型表情中严重程度与成绩的耦合，这与视觉证据不足时共同依赖感觉运动信息相一致；只有Moebius队列在原型表情中也表现出这种耦合，这与终生非典型面部运动经验后视觉模板校准不足相一致。探索性脑电图（EEG）显示，Moebius患者的感觉运动—面部网络功能连接降低，这与跨通路整合改变相一致。对一组独立的超模糊静态变形数据集进行再分析，复现了严重程度与成绩的耦合，并发现Moebius与对照组均值差异仅在高知觉需求条件下出现。总体而言，这些发现为“模糊性门控、发展性校准”架构提供了强有力的行为学支持，并推动直接检验发展性运动经验如何塑造识别系统何时以及以多强程度依赖感觉运动信息。
关键词：面部情绪识别；感觉运动信息；面瘫；Moebius综合征；模糊性门控

title: Differentiation of frontolimbic functional connectivity from birth to early adulthood links with adversity exposure and cognition.
summary: Frontolimbic circuits connecting the frontal cortex with the amygdala and the hippocampus are critical for emotion and learning. These connections undergo major changes throughout childhood and adolescence, yet the principles guiding their maturation remain unclear. Analyzing large developmental cohorts, we show that fronto-hippocampus connectivity develops rapidly in early childhood and stabilizes thereafter. In contrast, fronto-amygdala connectivity becomes progressively differentiated from fronto-hippocampus connectivity, with development most pronounced during adolescence. This entailed hippocampus and amygdala respectively becoming preferentially tethered to association-related regions and sensorimotor-related regions. Greater adversity exposure was associated with more differentiated fronto-amygdala connectivity for a given age. Higher cognitive ability was associated with less differentiated fronto-hippocampus connectivity. These findings suggest that frontolimbic connectivity development follows a principle of differentiation, with circuit-specific timing and sensitivity to stress and learning. This work provides a foundation for understanding typical and atypical frontolimbic circuitry development from birth to emerging adulthood.

标题：从前额-边缘系统功能连接的分化看从出生到成年早期的逆境暴露与认知关联
摘要：连接额叶皮层与杏仁核及海马的前额-边缘系统回路对情绪与学习至关重要。这些连接在儿童期和青少年期经历重大变化，但其成熟过程的指导原则仍不清楚。通过分析大型发育队列，我们发现额-海马连接在幼儿期快速发展，此后趋于稳定。相反，额-杏仁核连接逐渐从额-海马连接中分化出来，这一发育过程在青少年期最为显著。这意味着海马和杏仁核分别优先与联合相关区域和感觉运动相关区域绑定。在给定年龄下，更大的逆境暴露与更分化的额-杏仁核连接相关。更高的认知能力与更少分化的额-海马连接相关。这些发现表明，前额-边缘系统连接发育遵循分化原则，具有回路特异性时序以及对压力和学习的敏感性。这项工作为理解从出生到成年早期的典型与非典型前额-边缘系统回路发育提供了基础。
关键词：前额-边缘系统连接；情绪；逆境暴露；认知；发育分化

title: A role for self-regulatory control in the absence of ingroup preference.
summary: One of psychology's most ubiquitous findings is that of robust ingroup preference, an explicitly stated human preference for the groups to which we belong. The advent of implicit measures of social cognition introduced a paradoxical result: Compared to members of higher-status groups, members of lower-status groups often show no implicit ingroup preference, sometimes even showing outgroup preference, a result rarely observed on explicit measures. Prevailing theories have provided macro-level accounts, often in terms of system-justifying tendencies, but the various cognitive processes that could produce such an absence of ingroup preference among lower-status groups have not been directly decomposed. In this paper, we address this gap via formal process modeling applied to data from 5.7 million respondents collected across 16 years and 6 social categories. We find that, among lower-status groups, ingroup-affirming evaluations are accompanied by more pronounced self-regulatory control than outgroup-affirming evaluations, a regulatory asymmetry absent among higher-status groups. For example, evaluations affirming Black and overweight ingroups were accompanied by heightened self-regulatory control, whereas a comparable self-regulatory pattern was not observed for evaluations affirming White and nonoverweight ingroups. The evidence points to a previously unrecognized role for self-regulatory control in the absence of ingroup preference, suggesting that the cognitive imprint of social hierarchies may extend beyond evaluative associations to the regulatory processes that govern their expression.

标题：自我调节控制在缺乏内群体偏好中的作用
摘要：心理学中最普遍的发现之一是稳健的内群体偏好，即人们明确表达出对自己所属群体的偏好。社会认知内隐测量的出现引入了一个悖论性结果：与高地位群体成员相比，低地位群体成员往往不表现出内隐内群体偏好，有时甚至表现出外群体偏好，而这一结果在外显测量中很少观察到。主流理论提供了宏观层面的解释，通常诉诸系统正当化倾向，但能够导致低地位群体中这种内群体偏好缺失的各种认知过程尚未被直接分解。本文通过对16年间、6个社会类别、570万名受访者数据应用形式化过程建模，填补了这一空白。我们发现，在低地位群体中，肯定内群体的评价伴随比肯定外群体的评价更明显的自我调节控制，而这种调节不对称在高地位群体中并不存在。例如，肯定黑人和超重内群体的评价伴随更高的自我调节控制，而肯定白人和非超重内群体的评价则未观察到类似的自我调节模式。这些证据指向自我调节控制在缺乏内群体偏好中一个此前未被认识的作用，表明社会等级的认知印记可能超越评价性联想，延伸到支配其表达的调节过程。
关键词：内群体偏好；自我调节控制；社会认知；内隐测量；社会等级

title: The structural dynamics of music drive acute stress recovery through functional reorganization of stress-regulation networks.
summary: Music is widely utilized to support recovery from stress, yet the precise neural mechanisms driving this therapeutic effect remain poorly understood. Crucially, it has been unclear whether music provides unique neurobiological benefits or simply acts as a general, relaxing auditory stimulus. Here, we demonstrate that music selectively facilitates multisystem recovery from acute stress-enhancing positive mood (PM) and accelerating autonomic stabilization (electrodermal activity and heart rate)-significantly outperforming an active natural sound control. Using functional MRI and dynamic causal modeling, we revealed the network architecture underlying this advantage. Compared to natural sounds, music drives a distinct reorganization of stress-regulation networks, establishing a directional, causal pathway from the auditory cortex to the insula and thalamus. On a faster timescale, dynamic functional connectivity reveals that this network reconfiguration is actively governed by musical structure: moment-to-moment fluctuations in perceived musical tension track transient shifts from stress-network engagement to neural downregulation. Furthermore, these music-specific connectivity changes are directly associated with improvements in PM. Together, these findings identify a temporally evolving mechanism by which the brain's processing of structured musical sequences acts as a dynamic regulatory driver, reconfiguring neural architectures to restore psychological and physiological homeostasis.

标题：音乐的结构动态通过应激调节网络的功能重组驱动急性应激恢复
摘要：音乐被广泛用于支持应激恢复，然而驱动这一治疗效应的精确神经机制仍知之甚少。关键问题在于，音乐是否提供独特的神经生物学益处，还是仅作为一种一般的放松性听觉刺激发挥作用。本研究证明，音乐选择性地促进急性应激后的多系统恢复——增强积极情绪（PM）并加速自主神经稳定（皮肤电活动和心率）——显著优于主动的自然声音对照。借助功能磁共振成像和动态因果建模，我们揭示了支撑这一优势的网络架构。与自然声音相比，音乐驱动应激调节网络的独特重组，建立起从听觉皮层到岛叶和丘脑的方向性因果通路。在更快的时间尺度上，动态功能连接揭示这种网络重构受音乐结构的主动调控：感知音乐张力的逐刻波动追踪着从应激网络参与到神经下调的瞬时转换。此外，这些音乐特异性的连接变化与积极情绪的改善直接相关。总之，这些发现识别出一种时间演化机制，即大脑对结构化音乐序列的加工充当动态调节驱动力，重构神经架构以恢复心理和生理稳态。
关键词：音乐；急性应激恢复；应激调节网络；功能重组；动态因果建模

title: Fear of negative evaluation as a longitudinal mediator between maternal psychological control and social avoidance in adolescents: A cross-lagged panel model.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Although perceived maternal psychological control (pMPC) and fear of negative evaluation (FNE) are both well-established correlates of social anxiety, their longitudinal interplay with social avoidance remains poorly understood. The present study examined the temporal associations between pMPC, FNE, and social avoidance in a three-wave longitudinal design.
METHODS: Participants were 608 adolescents aged 10-16 years (Mage = 12.89) who completed self-report measures at three time points over six months. Cross-lagged panel models with latent variables were estimated, and multigroup analyses tested moderation by age and sex.
RESULTS: Across the full sample, pMPC predicted subsequent increases in FNE (T1 → T2: β = 0.04, p < .001), which in turn predicted higher levels of social avoidance (T2 → T3: β = 0.10, p < .001). The indirect effect of pMPC on avoidance via FNE was significant (p = .001), suggesting an indirect prospective pathway. Bidirectional associations between FNE and avoidance further indicated a self-reinforcing anxiety process. Importantly, these associations were not uniform across groups. The mediating pathway was significant only among boys, suggesting potential sex-specific transactional dynamics.
CONCLUSION: This study is the first to longitudinally demonstrate that FNE represents a prospective pathway, though modest in effect size, linking pMPC to anxious social avoidance in youth. The findings highlight the importance of considering cognitive mediators and child characteristics when examining family influences on adolescent social anxiety.

标题：负面评价恐惧作为母亲心理控制与青少年社交回避之间的纵向中介：一项交叉滞后面板模型
摘要：背景：尽管感知到的母亲心理控制（pMPC）和负面评价恐惧（FNE）均已被证实与社交焦虑相关，但它们与社交回避之间的纵向相互作用仍知之甚少。本研究采用三波纵向设计，考察pMPC、FNE与社交回避之间的时间关联。方法：参与者为608名10-16岁青少年（平均年龄=12.89岁），在六个月内的三个时间点完成自我报告测量。研究估计了带潜变量的交叉滞后面板模型，并通过多组分析检验年龄和性别的调节作用。结果：在全样本中，pMPC预测了随后FNE的增加（T1→T2：β=0.04，p<.001），而FNE又预测了更高水平的社交回避（T2→T3：β=0.10，p<.001）。pMPC通过FNE对回避的间接效应显著（p=.001），提示存在间接的前瞻性路径。FNE与回避之间的双向关联进一步表明存在自我强化的焦虑过程。重要的是，这些关联在不同群体间并不一致。中介路径仅在男孩中显著，提示可能存在性别特异性的交易性动态。结论：本研究首次纵向证明，FNE代表了一条前瞻性路径，尽管效应量较小，将pMPC与青少年焦虑性社交回避联系起来。研究结果强调，在考察家庭对青少年社交焦虑的影响时，应考虑认知中介因素和儿童特征。
关键词：负面评价恐惧；母亲心理控制；社交回避；青少年；交叉滞后面板模型

title: The relation of depressive symptoms to social-emotional expertise in adults.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Social cognition refers to the mental processes required for effective social interactions. The negative relation of depression to most aspects of social cognition has been well established. However, social-emotional expertise (SEE) is the social-cognitive ability to effectively adapt and express verbal and nonverbal behavior in social interaction. The relation of depression to SEE deficits has not been well-documented.
METHOD: The current study examined the relation of SEE to depressive symptoms in adults and explored associations of depression factors (somatic symptoms, depressed affect, positive affect, and interpersonal problems) to SEE factors (expressivity and adaptability). Participants were recruited through Qualtrics Panels and completed self-report measures of SEE and depressive symptoms. Participants were oversampled for high levels of depressive symptoms. Of 219 adults (Mage = 52.28, SD = 17.68 years; 58% female); 110 reported high levels of depression, and 109 reported low levels of depression.
RESULTS: In linear regression analyses, depressive symptoms were negatively associated with SEE (β = -0.46, p < .001), adaptability (β = -0.48, p < .001), and expressivity (β = -0.38, p < .001), and of depression factors, only interpersonal problems (βs ranged from -0.32 to -0.38, ps < 0.001) and positive affect (βs ranged from -0.24 to -0.36, ps < 0.001) were negatively associated with SEE, adaptability, and expressivity.
LIMITATIONS: This investigation was limited by self-report and cross-sectional design.
CONCLUSIONS: SEE is related to current experiences of depression, particularly interpersonal difficulties and reductions in positive affect. Future work examining tailored interventions for depression may benefit from a focus on adapting to and being expressive in social interactions.

标题：抑郁症状与成人社会情绪专长的关系
摘要：背景：社会认知是指有效社会互动所需的心理过程。抑郁与大多数社会认知方面的负向关系已被充分确立。然而，社会情绪专长（SEE）是指在社交互动中有效适应并表达言语和非言语行为的社会认知能力。抑郁与SEE缺陷之间的关系尚未得到充分记录。方法：本研究考察了成人中SEE与抑郁症状的关系，并探讨了抑郁因子（躯体症状、抑郁情感、积极情感和人际问题）与SEE因子（表达性和适应性）之间的关联。参与者通过Qualtrics Panels招募，并完成SEE和抑郁症状的自评量表。参与者被过度抽样以纳入高抑郁症状者。在219名成人中（平均年龄=52.28，标准差=17.68岁；58%为女性），110人报告高水平抑郁，109人报告低水平抑郁。结果：在线性回归分析中，抑郁症状与SEE（β=-0.46，p<.001）、适应性（β=-0.48，p<.001）和表达性（β=-0.38，p<.001）呈负相关；在抑郁因子中，仅人际问题（βs范围为-0.32至-0.38，ps<0.001）和积极情感（βs范围为-0.24至-0.36，ps<0.001）与SEE、适应性和表达性呈负相关。局限：本研究受限于自评报告和横断面设计。结论：SEE与当前的抑郁体验有关，尤其是人际困难和积极情感的降低。未来针对抑郁的定制化干预研究可能受益于关注在社交互动中的适应和表达。
关键词：社会情绪专长；抑郁症状；人际问题；积极情感；面部/语音表达

title: Weekday daylight exposure buffers against depressive and anxiety symptoms in children: Evidence from a prospective cohort study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Depressive and anxiety symptoms are common and increasing among school-aged children. Daytime light exposure influences circadian and neurobiological pathways involved in emotional regulation, yet prospective evidence using objective light assessment in pediatric populations remains limited. Because children's routines are typically more structured during school days, weekday daytime light exposure may be more regular and biologically salient. We therefore examined whether weekday daytime light exposure duration predicts subsequent depressive and anxiety symptoms in children.
METHODS: In this longitudinal study, 932 children aged 7-11 years from two elementary schools in Chuzhou, China wore HOBO pendant sensors for five consecutive days to objectively assess personal light exposure. Cumulative durations above ≥250, ≥500, and ≥ 1000 lx were calculated separately for weekdays and weekends. Depressive and anxiety symptoms were parent-reported at baseline and self-reported 19 months later. Multivariable linear and logistic regression models estimated associations with continuous symptom scores and clinically elevated symptoms after adjusting for sociodemographic and behavioral factors and baseline symptoms. Restricted cubic splines examined non-linearity.
RESULTS: Greater weekday daytime light exposure was prospectively associated with lower depressive symptom scores across all thresholds and reduced odds of clinically elevated depressive symptoms. For anxiety, longer weekday exposure was associated with lower symptom scores across all thresholds, but only duration ≥1000 lx exposure was associated with reduced odds of clinically elevated anxiety (OR = 0.55, P = 0.031). Weekend daytime light exposure was not significantly associated with either outcome.
CONCLUSION: Consistent daytime light exposure during structured school days may represent an important environmental factor supporting emotional health in children.

标题：工作日日光暴露对儿童抑郁和焦虑症状的缓冲作用：来自前瞻性队列研究的证据
摘要：背景：抑郁和焦虑症状在学龄儿童中普遍存在且日益增多。日间光照暴露影响参与情绪调节的昼夜节律和神经生物学通路，但在儿科人群中采用客观光照评估的前瞻性证据仍然有限。由于儿童的日常作息在上学日通常更为规律，工作日的日间光照暴露可能更为规律且具有更强的生物学显著性。因此，我们检验了工作日日间光照暴露时长是否预测儿童随后的抑郁和焦虑症状。方法：在这项纵向研究中，来自中国滁州两所小学的932名7-11岁儿童连续五天佩戴HOBO吊坠传感器，以客观评估个人光照暴露。分别计算工作日和周末累积暴露时长达到≥250、≥500和≥1000勒克斯的情况。抑郁和焦虑症状在基线时由家长报告，19个月后由儿童自我报告。多变量线性回归和逻辑回归模型在调整社会人口学和行为因素及基线症状后，估计了与连续症状评分及临床显著症状的关联。限制性立方样条检验了非线性关系。结果：较大的工作日日间光照暴露在所有阈值下均前瞻性地与较低的抑郁症状评分相关，并降低临床显著抑郁症状的几率。对于焦虑，较长的工作日暴露在所有阈值下均与较低的症状评分相关，但仅≥1000勒克斯暴露时长与临床显著焦虑的几率降低相关（OR=0.55，P=0.031）。周末日间光照暴露与任一结局均无显著关联。结论：在结构化的上学日期间持续进行日间光照暴露可能是支持儿童情绪健康的重要环境因素。
关键词：日光暴露；抑郁症状；焦虑症状；儿童；情绪调节

title: Altered effective connectivity among reward network and triple network in patients with melancholic depression and their associated gene expression profiles.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: Melancholic depression has more severe clinical manifestations, and its mechanism remains unclear. The deficit of reward network (RN) has been reported to be strongly related to anhedonia of melancholic depression. The triple network, including the default-mode network (DMN), executive control network (ECN), and salience network (SN), was found to exhibit abnormal functional coupling across many mental processes. Whether activities of the RN and its connectivity with the triple network could affect emotional symptoms in melancholic depression is worth exploring.
METHODS: 59 outpatients with first-episode, drug-naïve major depressive disorder (31 melancholic, 28 non-melancholic) and 32 healthy controls were enrolled for resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging to evaluate the effective connectivity (EC) by using spectral dynamic causal modeling approach. Utilizing the Allen Human Brain Atlas, transcriptome-neuroimaging analysis was applied to identify EC-related gene expression profiles.
RESULTS: Compared with non-melancholic group, there were both increased and decreased ECs between these networks in melancholic group. From network perspective, increased and excitatory ECs were observed from RN to ECN, from ECN to DMN and SN. RN-related PLS1 genes in melancholic patients were related to several biological functions. Pathway enrichment analysis revealed their involvement in the MAPK signaling pathways.
CONCLUSIONS: Our findings indicated that the primary mechanism of melancholic depression may involve disrupted functional interactions between the RN and large-scale brain networks, rather than abnormalities confined to isolated intra-network. Besides, our findings revealed correlations between these EC patterns in RN and gene expression profiles, which shed light on the potential genetic mechanisms underlying melancholic depression.

标题：忧郁型抑郁症患者奖赏网络与三重网络间有效连接改变及其相关基因表达谱
摘要：目的：忧郁型抑郁症临床表现更为严重，其机制尚不明确。奖赏网络（RN）缺陷已被报道与忧郁型抑郁症的快感缺失密切相关。三重网络，包括默认模式网络（DMN）、执行控制网络（ECN）和凸显网络（SN），已被发现于多种心理过程中表现出异常功能耦合。RN的活动及其与三重网络的连接是否会影响忧郁型抑郁症的情绪症状，值得探讨。方法：纳入59例首发、未用药的重性抑郁障碍门诊患者（31例忧郁型，28例非忧郁型）和32名健康对照，进行静息态功能磁共振成像，采用谱动态因果建模方法评估有效连接（EC）。利用艾伦人脑图谱，应用转录组-神经影像分析以识别与EC相关的基因表达谱。结果：与非忧郁型组相比，忧郁型组在这些网络之间既有增强也有减弱的EC。从网络角度看，观察到从RN到ECN、从ECN到DMN和SN的增强且兴奋性的EC。忧郁型患者中RN相关的PLS1基因与多种生物学功能相关。通路富集分析揭示其参与MAPK信号通路。结论：我们的发现表明，忧郁型抑郁症的主要机制可能涉及RN与大规模脑网络之间功能交互的破坏，而非局限于孤立网络内部的异常。此外，我们的发现揭示了RN中这些EC模式与基因表达谱之间的相关性，为忧郁型抑郁症潜在的遗传机制提供了线索。
关键词：忧郁型抑郁症；奖赏网络；三重网络；有效连接；基因表达谱

title: Evening chronotype is associated with affective temperaments, emotional dysregulation, and bipolar-spectrum features: An observational study in 1997 adults from a large community sample.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Growing evidence supports an association between chronotype and mental health, with evening chronotype (ET) being associated with increased vulnerability to bipolar disorder (BD).
METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional survey of adults recruited between February and September 2022 from community COVID-19 points of care in Padua, Italy. Participants completed validated self-report measures assessing chronotype (rMEQ), affective temperaments (Brief-TEMPS-M), emotion regulation (DERS), and subthreshold bipolarity (MDQ and HCL-32-R2). Group differences across chronotypes were examined using ANOVA. Associations between chronotype and psychopathological traits were assessed using regression models adjusted for age and sex. Logistic regression was used to identify sociodemographic and lifestyle factors associated with ET.
RESULTS: A total of 1997 participants (mean age = 31.4 ± 12.35 years; 66.3% female) were enrolled. Overall, 22.68% had ET, 22.33% morning chronotype (MT), and 54.98% neither chronotype (NT). Compared with other chronotypes, ET was associated with higher depressive, anxious, irritable, and cyclothymic temperament, greater emotional dysregulation, and increased bipolar-spectrum scores (all p < 0.001). In logistic regressions, obesity, student status, tobacco and drug use, and lack of religious belief increased the odds of ET, whereas older age, parenthood, living with other people, and good/excellent sleep quality decreased the odds. Cross-sectional design and regional sampling may limit generalizability.
CONCLUSIONS: Our findings support an association between ET and greater emotional dysregulation, cyclothymic temperament, and bipolar-spectrum features, suggesting that circadian-related patterns may be linked to mood instability. Chronotype may serve as a marker of bipolar-spectrum traits. Longitudinal studies are warranted to clarify causality and evaluate its integration into existing prediction/assessment tools for BD at-risk.

标题：晚睡型chronotype与情感气质、情绪失调及双相谱系特征相关：一项基于大型社区样本1997名成人的观察性研究
摘要：背景：越来越多的证据支持chronotype与心理健康之间存在关联，其中晚睡型（ET）与双相障碍（BD）易感性增加相关。方法：我们于2022年2月至9月在意大利帕多瓦的社区COVID-19诊疗点开展了一项成人横断面调查。参与者完成了经验证的自我报告量表，评估chronotype（rMEQ）、情感气质（Brief-TEMPS-M）、情绪调节（DERS）以及亚临床双相性（MDQ和HCL-32-R2）。采用方差分析检验不同chronotype之间的组间差异。采用回归模型评估chronotype与精神病理特征之间的关联，并校正年龄和性别。采用逻辑回归识别与ET相关的社会人口学和生活方式因素。结果：共纳入1997名参与者（平均年龄=31.4±12.35岁；66.3%为女性）。总体而言，22.68%为ET，22.33%为晨型（MT），54.98%为中间型（NT）。与其他chronotype相比，ET与更高的抑郁、焦虑、易激惹和环性气质、更严重的情绪失调以及更高的双相谱系评分相关（均p<0.001）。在逻辑回归中，肥胖、学生身份、烟草和药物使用以及缺乏宗教信仰增加了ET的比值比，而年龄较大、为人父母、与他人同住以及良好/极佳的睡眠质量降低了其比值比。横断面设计和区域抽样可能限制可推广性。结论：我们的发现支持ET与更严重的情绪失调、环性气质和双相谱系特征之间存在关联，提示昼夜节律相关模式可能与情绪不稳定有关。Chronotype可能作为双相谱系特质的标志物。有必要开展纵向研究以阐明因果关系，并评估其纳入现有BD高风险人群预测/评估工具的可能性。
关键词：晚睡型；情绪失调；情感气质；双相谱系；昼夜节律

title: Treatment-resistant depression is associated with reduced brain entropy.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Brain entropy reflects the brain's functional complexity and encompasses both cognitive and affective processing. However, brain entropy remains to be systematically examined in patients with treatment-resistant depression (TRD).
METHODS: The study cohort comprised 48 adults with TRD and 38 healthy controls. All participants underwent resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging. Sample entropy, an index of brain entropy, was calculated from blood oxygenation level-dependent time series for each of 166 regions of interest.
RESULTS: At an embedding dimension (m) of 1 and a tolerance (r) of 0.5, patients with TRD exhibited significantly lower entropy in the right angular gyrus, left cerebellar Crus II, and median raphe nucleus than did healthy controls. At r = 0.4, resting-state entropy was relatively broadly reduced in patients with TRD across the following regions: bilateral inferior frontal operculum; left gyrus rectus; right posterior orbitofrontal cortex; right angular gyrus; left inferior parietal cortex; bilateral cerebellar Crus II; cerebellar vermis lobules IV, V, VI, and VII; anterior cingulate cortex; thalamic nuclei; nucleus accumbens; ventral tegmental area; left red nucleus; and median raphe nucleus. These regions correspond to canonical large-scale networks, including the salience, default mode, reward, and cerebellar affective and motor networks, and involve thalamocortical and serotonergic pathways.
DISCUSSION: System-wide hypofunction, reflected by reduced entropy across large-scale networks, the cerebellum, and the median raphe nucleus, was associated with TRD.

标题：难治性抑郁症与脑熵降低相关
摘要：背景：脑熵反映大脑的功能复杂性，并涵盖认知与情感加工。然而，难治性抑郁症（TRD）患者的脑熵尚未得到系统考察。方法：研究队列包括48名TRD成人和38名健康对照。所有参与者均接受静息态功能磁共振成像。对166个感兴趣区中的每一个，基于血氧水平依赖时间序列计算样本熵，作为脑熵指标。结果：在嵌入维数（m）为1、容差（r）为0.5时，TRD患者在右侧角回、左侧小脑Crus II和中缝中核的熵显著低于健康对照。在r=0.4时，TRD患者的静息态熵在以下区域相对广泛降低：双侧额下岛盖部；左侧直回；右侧后部眶额皮层；右侧角回；左侧顶下皮层；双侧小脑Crus II；小脑蚓部IV、V、VI和VII小叶；前扣带皮层；丘脑核团；伏隔核；腹侧被盖区；左侧红核；以及中缝中核。这些区域对应经典的大规模网络，包括突显网络、默认模式网络、奖赏网络以及小脑情感和运动网络，并涉及丘脑皮层和血清素能通路。讨论：由大规模网络、小脑和中缝中核熵降低所反映的全系统功能低下与TRD相关。
关键词：难治性抑郁症；脑熵；静息态功能磁共振成像；大规模脑网络；中缝中核

title: Reduced P3 amplitudes during disgust conditioning in individuals with contamination-related obsessive-compulsive symptoms: Evidence from an analogue study.
summary: Although contemporary models of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) have primarily emphasized fear, recent accounts suggest that abnormal disgust learning may also contribute to OCD pathology, particularly in contamination-related OCD (C-OCD). The present study examined the neural correlates of disgust learning in individuals with elevated contamination-related obsessive-compulsive symptoms. Event-related potentials (ERPs) were recorded while 28 participants high in contamination-related obsessive-compulsive symptoms (HC) and 30 participants low in such symptoms (LC) completed disgust acquisition and extinction tasks. Behavioral measures included unconditioned stimulus (US) expectancy and conditioned stimulus (CS) disgust ratings, alongside electrophysiological indices of conditioned disgust. During acquisition, the HC group showed higher US expectancy for the CS+ than the LC group. At the neural level, both groups showed larger P3 amplitudes to the CS+ than to the CS-, indicating enhanced attentional significance. However, the HC group exhibited smaller overall P3 amplitudes than the LC group, which may reflect greater avoidance during disgust learning. During extinction, US expectancy differences between the CS+ and CS- remained evident in both groups, whereas P3 differences were no longer observed, suggesting a dissociation between self-reported and neural responses. Overall, these findings indicate that individuals with elevated contamination fear show enhanced disgust acquisition and altered neural processing during disgust learning, which may help clarify how maladaptive disgust responses are formed and maintained in contamination-related OCD.

标题：污染相关强迫症状个体在厌恶条件反射中P3波幅降低：一项类比研究证据
摘要：尽管当代强迫症（OCD）模型主要强调恐惧，近期研究提示异常的厌恶学习也可能参与OCD病理机制，尤其是在污染相关强迫症（C-OCD）中。本研究考察了污染相关强迫症状升高个体中厌恶学习的神经相关物。研究记录了28名污染相关强迫症状高分组（HC）参与者和30名低分组（LC）参与者在完成厌恶习得与消退任务时的事件相关电位（ERP）。行为测量包括无条件刺激（US）预期和条件刺激（CS）厌恶评分，同时结合条件性厌恶的电生理指标。在习得阶段，HC组对CS+的US预期高于LC组。在神经层面，两组均对CS+表现出比CS-更大的P3波幅，表明注意显著性增强。然而，HC组的整体P3波幅小于LC组，这可能反映了厌恶学习过程中更强的回避。在消退阶段，两组中CS+与CS-之间的US预期差异仍然明显，而P3差异不再出现，提示自我报告与神经反应之间存在分离。总体而言，这些发现表明污染恐惧升高个体表现出增强的厌恶习得和厌恶学习过程中 altered neural processing，这有助于阐明污染相关OCD中适应不良厌恶反应的形成与维持机制。
关键词：厌恶条件反射；强迫症；污染恐惧；P3波幅；事件相关电位

title: Emotional schemas and metacognitive beliefs in anxiety and depression: A network approach.
summary: Anxiety and depression are prevalent and comorbid, and transdiagnostic models highlight emotional schemas and metacognitive beliefs as relevant to emotional distress. However, little is known about their interplay within a network or whether centrality differs by symptom severity. Treatment-seeking adults (N = 1459; Mage = 34.98; 62% female) completed the LESS-II, MCQ-30, BDI, and BAI. Networks were estimated using Gaussian graphical models with EBICglasso regularization. Centrality indices were examined, and networks were compared between participants with clinically significant symptom levels (n = 797) and those without (n = 662). Loss of Control, Negative Metacognitive Beliefs about Uncontrollability and Danger, Non-Acceptance of Feelings, and Low Expression showed the highest centrality. The strongest edges linked Loss of Control with Non-Acceptance of Feelings and Duration, and Negative Metacognitive Beliefs about Uncontrollability and Danger with Need for Control. Centrality differences indicated higher strength and expected influence for Anxiety and Low Consensus in the non-clinical group, and higher strength for Negative Metacognitive Beliefs about Uncontrollability and Danger in the same group. At the edge level, several differences emerged across groups, including a stronger Anxiety-Negative Metacognitive Beliefs about Uncontrollability and Danger association in the non-clinical group and stronger Loss of Control-Non-Acceptance of Feelings and Numbness-related links in the clinical group. Emotional schemas and metacognitive beliefs are closely connected within a network of emotional distress, although longitudinal research is needed to evaluate temporal dynamics.

标题：焦虑与抑郁中的情绪图式与元认知信念：一种网络分析方法
摘要：焦虑与抑郁普遍存在且常共病，跨诊断模型强调情绪图式与元认知信念与情绪困扰相关。然而，关于二者在网络中的相互作用或中心性是否随症状严重程度而异，目前知之甚少。寻求治疗的成年人（N=1459；平均年龄=34.98；62%为女性）完成了LESS-II、MCQ-30、BDI和BAI。采用高斯图模型并结合EBICglasso正则化估计网络。检验了中心性指标，并比较了具有临床显著症状水平的参与者（n=797）与无临床显著症状者（n=662）之间的网络。失控感、关于不可控性与危险的负性元认知信念、对感受的不接纳以及低表达表现出最高的中心性。最强的边连接了失控感与对感受的不接纳及持续时间，以及关于不可控性与危险的负性元认知信念与控制需求。中心性差异表明，非临床组中焦虑和低共识的强度与预期影响更高，且同一组中关于不可控性与危险的负性元认知信念的强度更高。在边水平上，各组之间出现了若干差异，包括非临床组中焦虑与关于不可控性与危险的负性元认知信念之间的关联更强，以及临床组中失控感与对感受的不接纳及麻木相关联系更强。情绪图式与元认知信念在情绪困扰网络中紧密相连，尽管仍需纵向研究来评估时间动态。
关键词：情绪图式；元认知信念；焦虑；抑郁；网络分析

title: Neurobiological Signatures of Trauma, Personality, and Depressivity: A Transdiagnostic Machine Learning Study in Adolescents and Young Adults.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Adolescence and early adulthood are periods of increased vulnerability for psychiatric disorders, when trauma and personality development converge on shared and distinct, often unknown, brain signatures.
METHODS: We used sparse partial least squares (SPLS) to identify multivariate signatures between voxelwise gray matter volume (GMV) and the following 3 domains: childhood trauma, personality, and depressivity. We performed structural equation modeling (SEM) among these domains, predicted functional outcome at 9-month follow-up via support vector machine classification, and correlated the SPLS signatures with resilience, coping, and visual dysfunctions. All models were cross-validated in the discovery sample [n = 633; 52.9% female, mean [SD] age = 25.41 [5.98] years] and validated in the replication sample (n = 343; 53.0% female, 24.69 [5.72] years) of the multisite prospective PRONIA (Personalised Prognostic Tools for Early Psychosis Management) cohort, comprising individuals with recent-onset depression or psychosis, psychosis risk syndromes, and healthy control individuals.
RESULTS: We identified the following 3 signatures of interest: 1) depressivity, linked to reduced GMV in limbic regions; 2) childhood trauma, associated with GMV in thalamic, frontotemporal, and parietal regions; and 3) a trauma-personality-depressivity signature, relating childhood trauma, personality, and depressivity to GMV in thalamic, occipital, temporal, and limbic regions. SEM revealed that childhood trauma was associated with depressivity directly and also indirectly via a maladaptive personality structure. The trauma-personality-depressivity signature was the strongest predictor of poor functional outcome (balanced accuracy [BAC]Discovery = 75.8%, BACReplication = 83.2%). The depressivity and trauma-personality-depressivity signatures were linked to deficient resilience and coping styles as well as visual dysfunctions.
CONCLUSIONS: Childhood trauma, personality, and depressivity are associated with shared and distinct brain signatures spanning the affective-psychotic spectrum. If these factors converge, current and future mental health may be compromised.

标题：创伤、人格与抑郁的神经生物学特征：一项在青少年和年轻成人中开展的跨诊断机器学习研究
摘要：背景：青春期和成年早期是精神障碍易感性增加的时期，此时创伤与人格发展在共享且独特、且往往未知的大脑特征上发生交汇。方法：我们使用稀疏偏最小二乘法（SPLS）识别体素级灰质体积（GMV）与以下3个领域之间的多变量特征：童年创伤、人格和抑郁。我们在这3个领域之间进行了结构方程建模（SEM），通过支持向量机分类预测9个月随访时的功能结局，并将SPLS特征与心理韧性、应对方式和视觉功能障碍进行相关分析。所有模型均在发现样本中进行交叉验证[ n = 633；52.9%为女性，平均[SD]年龄 = 25.41[5.98]岁]，并在多中心前瞻性PRONIA（早期精神病管理个性化预后工具）队列的复制样本中验证（n = 343；53.0%为女性，24.69[5.72]岁），该队列包括近期起病抑郁或精神病个体、精神病风险综合征个体和健康对照个体。结果：我们识别出以下3个感兴趣的特征：1）抑郁，与边缘区域GMV降低相关；2）童年创伤，与丘脑、额颞和顶叶区域GMV相关；3）创伤-人格-抑郁特征，将童年创伤、人格和抑郁与丘脑、枕叶、颞叶和边缘区域GMV相关联。SEM显示，童年创伤与抑郁直接相关，也通过适应不良的人格结构间接相关。创伤-人格-抑郁特征是功能结局不良的最强预测因子（平衡准确率[BAC]发现样本 = 75.8%，BAC复制样本 = 83.2%）。抑郁特征和创伤-人格-抑郁特征与心理韧性和应对方式缺陷以及视觉功能障碍相关。结论：童年创伤、人格和抑郁与跨越情感-精神病谱系的共享且独特的大脑特征相关。如果这些因素发生汇聚，当前和未来的心理健康可能受到损害。
关键词：童年创伤；人格；抑郁；机器学习；神经影像

title: Childhood Electroencephalographic Signatures Predict Distinct Developmental Trajectories to Adolescent Anxiety and Depression.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Adolescence is a vulnerable period for the onset of anxiety and depression, yet their neurodevelopmental origins remain unclear.
METHODS: In this 7-year prospective longitudinal study (N = 64), we recorded resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) data in children at ages 7, 9, and 11 years, followed by functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) and symptom assessments at age 13. Using connectome-based predictive modeling, we examined whether childhood EEG patterns could predict adolescent symptoms, with rigorous control analyses and external validation in the Healthy Brain Network (HBN) dataset (N = 384). We further characterized the developmental trajectories of these predictive networks. To mechanistically ground these electrophysiological markers, we conducted mediation analyses to test whether the amygdala-seeded circuits mediate the link between childhood EEG dynamics and adolescent symptom severity.
RESULTS: We identified dissociable EEG indicators emerging at age 9 that predicted adolescent anxiety (alpha, 8-12 Hz) and depression (beta-1, 12-18 Hz). Importantly, the dynamic maturation of these EEG networks highlighted distinct neurodevelopmental susceptibilities, in which longitudinal EEG shifts between ages 9 and 11 predicted symptom severity in adolescence. The divergent developmental trajectories of EEG-based networks were characterized by opposing hemispheric lateralization: rightward for anxiety and leftward for depression. Mechanistically, these predictive associations were mediated by lateralized amygdala-ventrolateral prefrontal cortex (vlPFC) circuits, with the right and left vlPFC pathways selectively mediating anxiety risk and depression risk, respectively. These models generalized robustly to the independent HBN cohort.
CONCLUSIONS: Our findings highlight early neurobiological indicators of distinct developmental trajectories and susceptibilities for anxiety and depression, providing a foundation for early risk stratification and targeted precision prevention.

标题：儿童期脑电特征预测青少年焦虑与抑郁的不同发展轨迹
摘要：背景：青少年期是焦虑和抑郁发病的脆弱时期，但其神经发育起源仍不清楚。方法：在这项为期7年的前瞻性纵向研究（N = 64）中，我们在儿童7岁、9岁和11岁时记录其静息态脑电图（EEG）数据，随后在13岁时进行功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和症状评估。采用基于连接组的预测建模，我们检验了儿童期EEG模式是否能预测青少年期症状，并进行了严格的控制分析以及在健康脑网络（HBN）数据集（N = 384）中的外部验证。我们进一步刻画了这些预测网络的发展轨迹。为从机制上夯实这些电生理标记，我们进行了中介分析，以检验以杏仁核为种子的回路是否中介儿童期EEG动态与青少年期症状严重程度之间的联系。结果：我们识别出在9岁时出现的可分离的EEG指标，分别预测青少年期焦虑（alpha，8-12 Hz）和抑郁（beta-1，12-18 Hz）。重要的是，这些EEG网络的动态成熟凸显了不同的神经发育易感性，其中9至11岁间的纵向EEG变化预测了青少年期症状严重程度。基于EEG的网络的不同发展轨迹以相反的半球偏侧化为特征：焦虑为右侧化，抑郁为左侧化。在机制上，这些预测性关联由偏侧化的杏仁核-腹外侧前额叶皮层（vlPFC）回路中介，其中右侧和左侧vlPFC通路分别选择性地中介焦虑风险和抑郁风险。这些模型稳健地推广至独立的HBN队列。结论：我们的发现凸显了焦虑和抑郁不同发展轨迹与易感性的早期神经生物学指标，为早期风险分层和针对性精准预防提供了基础。
关键词：脑电图；焦虑；抑郁；神经发育轨迹；杏仁核-前额叶回路
